concept: warm stone monochrome on an off-white paper ground, flat geometric surfaces with a single soft light bevel, zero gloss
style_notes: dark 1px outline in the stone ink tones, no anti-aliasing, front-top light, 16-bit presentation

assets.name: bg
assets.description: View from INSIDE a quiet studio wall facing a wooden plank floor, seen from slightly above: the pale warm off-white wall and the floor cover the ENTIRE image edge to edge, corner to corner — no visible backdrop outside the room, no border, completely opaque. The wall is a plain warm stone off-white with a very faint etched grid of barely darker lines, the floor a slightly darker warm grey-tan with soft plank seams meeting the wall at a soft horizon line. Empty room: no furniture, no objects, no balls, no paddles, no text, no logos. Very low contrast, calm and receding so dark foreground pieces stand out; wide composition, nothing important at the edges.
